components.name: Navigation

components.html: RoamHow It WorksJOIN A HIKE ↗

narrative.overview: Roam feels like a small-run outdoor magazine assembled by people who actually went outside together. The navigation wordmark and photographic hero both use the title-case Roam treatment. Trova’s image-led pacing and Cabinet Grotesk heading style are retained while luxury-expedition polish is removed.

rules.name: Blue Means Movement
rules.body: Electric blue appears only where the visitor can act, navigate, or follow a route-like line.

rules.name: Two Registers
rules.body: Human invitations use confident sans-serif; dates, coordinates, distances, and hike numbers use compact mono.

rules.name: Flat Publication
rules.body: If an element needs separation, use spacing, a rule, or a change of field. The lightly frosted navigation is the single floating-surface exception.

dos: Treat route state, distance, date, and difficulty as first-class content.
Let one strong photograph own a viewport or section.
Keep operational route and RSVP states concise.
Use restrained transitions: the route-drawing moment and the slow Next Outing photograph frost on CTA hover.
donts: Introduce glossy gradients, fake film scratches, decorative shadows, or glass panels beyond the restrained navigation surface.
Use commercial travel-agency language or athletic performance framing.
Place every section in rounded cards.
Add warning copy that overwhelms the hike itself.
Set the Roam name in all caps; keep the navigation and photographic hero in title case.
